tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background and the top bar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards and the map plate. Also the 2px ring around every station dot.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Controls, tooltips, segmented-control track and the site list header.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px dividers and panel edges. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control that needs to be found.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text on bg, surface and raised (13:1 or more in both themes). Also the consensus (shared site) double ring.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and citations on bg, surface and raised (5.8:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, the active control and the 2px focus ring, on bg, surface and raised. Never used for stations or data.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill, such as the active segment.

tokens.name: tbd
tokens.usage: Missing-value labels ([TBD: ...]) with a dashed border, on bg, surface and raised.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Grid rule stations: filled circle. Method chip dot and method card top rule.

tokens.name: kmeans
tokens.usage: Weighted K-means stations: filled circle. Method chip dot and method card top rule.

tokens.name: mclp
tokens.usage: MCLP stations: filled circle. Method chip dot and method card top rule.

tokens.name: existing
tokens.usage: Existing four-wheeler chargers, drawn as an × mark (Scenario B).

tokens.name: consensus
tokens.usage: Shared site: a double open ring in ink.

tokens.name: demand-1
tokens.usage: Demand layer, step 1 of 5 (low to high). Brighter in dark, darker in light means more estimated demand.

tokens.name: demand-2
tokens.usage: Demand layer, step 2 of 5 (low to high). Brighter in dark, darker in light means more estimated demand.

tokens.name: demand-3
tokens.usage: Demand layer, step 3 of 5 (low to high). Brighter in dark, darker in light means more estimated demand.

tokens.name: demand-4
tokens.usage: Demand layer, step 4 of 5 (low to high). Brighter in dark, darker in light means more estimated demand.

tokens.name: demand-5
tokens.usage: Demand layer, step 5 of 5 (low to high). Brighter in dark, darker in light means more estimated demand.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero heading in the intro. One per page.
styles.sample: Where could Delhi's public EV chargers go?

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card headings, such as method cards.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text in the 720px reading column.
styles.sample: Nobody has measured charging demand, so we estimate it.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Short label above a heading. The only uppercase text.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Big figure in a stat block. Use tabular numerals.

styles.name: display-phone
styles.sample: Where could Delhi's public EV chargers go?

styles.name: body-phone
styles.sample: Public stations serve people who cannot charge at home.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between a dot and its label.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between related controls.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Padding in tooltips and table cells.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding on phones; gap between controls.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Space above a section heading.

tokens.name: space-72
tokens.usage: Space between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, segmented controls, inputs, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, the map plate. No pill-shaped cards.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the reading column.

tokens.name: explorer-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the explorer.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Height of the sticky top bar.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of toggles and site list rows.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: All borders and dividers.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring in accent.

tokens.name: station-ring
tokens.usage: Ring in surface around each station dot.

tokens.name: method-rule
tokens.usage: Top rule on method cards, in the method colour.
